Spatial content stopped being tech demos. Real brands are now filming stories meant to be lived inside, not watched on a rectangle.

01 Field notes

A football giant shot a film for spatial

Apple and Real Madrid teamed on an immersive documentary filmed during the 2025 to 2026 Champions League, with more than 30 Blackmagic immersive cameras capturing the match up close. It arrives in 2026 as premium content shot specifically for spatial viewing.

02
In the lab

The platform grew up around real content

visionOS 26 turns widgets spatial, adds lifelike depth to scenes, and supports 180 degree, 360 degree and wide field content from Insta360, GoPro and Canon. The pipeline to capture and publish spatial stories is finally something a normal crew can use.

03 Craft

Spatial is already working inside companies

It is not only marketing. KLM built an Engine Shop app that speeds up aircraft maintenance with spatial computing. The same depth that sells a story on the outside is training and guiding teams on the inside.
